claim.quote: We establish the most stringent cross section limits on spin-dependent WIMP-proton elastic scattering for the WIMP masses greater than 20 GeV/c2.

key_value_text.quote: The 90% upper limit of NR event rate for 3.6-5.8 keV corresponding to 2-4 keV in NaI(T) is 0.0098 counts/kg/keV/day which is below the annual modulation amplitude reported by DAMA.
key_value_text.value: The 90% upper limit of NR event rate for 3.6-5.8 keV corresponding to 2-4 keV in NaI(T) is 0.0098 counts/kg/keV/day which is below the annual modulation amplitude reported by DAMA.

name: New Limits on Interactions between Weakly Interacting Massive Particles and Nucleons Obtained with CsI(Tl) Crystal Detectors

summary.plain: With 24524.3 kg-days from the full 12-crystal array, KIMS set the best limits then available on spin-dependent WIMP-proton scattering for WIMPs above 20 GeV, and found its nuclear-recoil rate below the modulation amplitude DAMA reported.
summary.technical: 24524.3 kg d with 9 of 12 CsI(Tl) modules (alpha-emitter surface background identified and fitted); 90% upper limit of the nuclear-recoil rate for 3.6-5.8 keV (2-4 keV in NaI(Tl)) is 0.0098 counts/kg/keV/day, below the DAMA annual-modulation amplitude, which the abstract calls incompatible with interpretations that enhance the modulation such as inelastic dark matter (Phys. Rev. Lett. 108, 181301 (2012)).

title: New Limits on Interactions between Weakly Interacting Massive Particles and Nucleons Obtained with CsI(Tl) Crystal Detectors
why_it_matters: The abstract compares directly with the DAMA modulation amplitude.
